audience: Owners and operations leaders in established Sydney service businesses
buyer: An owner of a profitable Sydney service business whose completed jobs still wait for someone to prepare the invoice
repeated_workflow: Move approved job completion, customer, scope and pricing information into a reviewable invoice draft
before_state: Finished jobs sit in messages, job sheets or memory while someone retypes details and checks whether scope changed
mechanism: Use an approved completion status to collect confirmed commercial details, prepare the draft and route exceptions to the responsible person
problem: Finished work waits for someone to re-enter job details before invoicing can begin.
single_message: Finished work should trigger a reviewable invoice workflow
supporting_points: Prepare the invoice from confirmed source data
Keep price changes, disputes and approval human
angle: Use the approved job status and confirmed commercial details to prepare the invoice workflow automatically, then keep price changes, disputes and final approval with the responsible person.
headline_options: How can a service business automate invoicing after a job?
Stop retyping completed jobs into invoices
selected_headline: How can a service business automate invoicing after a job?
caption_hook_options: The job is done. Why is invoicing waiting?
Completed work should not sit in a queue
caption_cta: Map one completed job from sign-off to invoice approval
visual_concept: A real service-business workbench where a completed job folder moves into an invoice preparation tray and one terracotta exception card stays with a person
image_generation_prompt: Premium photorealistic Australian field-service workbench with a completed job folder, invoice preparation tray and terracotta human-review exception card, earthy Run Lighter palette, no people, text, logos or generic AI imagery
search_question: How can a service business automate invoicing after a job?
direct_answer: Use the approved job status and confirmed commercial details to prepare the invoice workflow automatically, then keep price changes, disputes and final approval with the responsible person.
promotion_hypothesis: The invoicing handover is commercially relevant and visually concrete, but paid promotion remains on hold until qualified lead outcomes are recorded.
risk_notes: Do not imply that every invoice can be sent without review
Do not invent time or cash-flow outcomes
Keep pricing, disputes and approval under human judgement
